title: Check: CRDs and operators
description: Five questions on extending the API.

questions.prompt: What does a CustomResourceDefinition give you?

options.text: A new resource type in the API, stored and served like any built-in

questions.explanation: The CRD adds the type. On its own nothing acts on the objects you create.

options.text: A controller that reconciles a custom resource, encoding operational knowledge

questions.explanation: CRD plus controller. The pattern is exactly the reconciliation loop the built-in controllers use.

questions.prompt: Write the command that lists the CustomResourceDefinitions in the cluster.
questions.explanation: `kubectl api-resources` then shows the custom kinds alongside the built-in ones.

questions.prompt: How does a CRD constrain the shape of its objects?

options.text: With an OpenAPI v3 schema in the CRD's versions

questions.explanation: The structural schema is what makes `kubectl explain` work for custom resources too.

questions.prompt: A CRD declares `scope: Namespaced`. What follows?

options.text: Its objects live in namespaces and are listed per namespace
It is only visible to admins

questions.explanation: The alternative is Cluster, like Node or PersistentVolume.
